skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Disguise
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Disguise. Home leisure style, snug and cozy material. Dark purple and tangerine yellow collide for a full-on sense of vogue.
skins.quote: Fashion trends change like the weather, and the same can be said of Utage's character. Which of her is real, in the end?

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA661
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA661. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.quote: When there is a will, there is a way. Sunshine can also become part of a trend.
